entry.author: Horowhenua District Council
entry.summary:
We build work readiness in our youth - from CV presentation and job searches, to interview prep, driver licensing, and training opportunities.
Then we connect motivated young people with local employers ready to invest in their future.

For employers, we simplify recruitment by providing work-ready candidates, supporting onboarding, and helping you find the right fit. We continue to work alongside you, with pastoral care that supports a sustainable employment outcome.

Locals supporting locals - strengthening our workforce and our community.
